profile.summary: Cycles of Change is an Oakland nonprofit that promotes cycling as safe, affordable transportation, mainly in East Oakland. It runs youth bike clubs, bike safety classes, mechanics training, and a community bike shop called The Bikery. It works mostly with low-income communities.

sources.title: Cycles Of Change - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The organization's site and ProPublica both show the Oakland 501(c)(3) Cycles of Change with EIN 11-3821114, an East Oakland youth bike and afterschool nonprofit with in-school programming, which fits OUSD's after-school and summer program contracts. The summary, contact fields, EIN and headquarters are all supported by the fetched sources and the tone is neutral.
